text:
Marta: Quick thread 16: finalize pricing estimator behavior + FAQ snips before design sprint. Also decide webinar gating rule for high-intent leads. Can we lock by EOD?

Ethan: TL;DR: prefer descriptive tier names. My draft: Starter (pay-as-you-go) / Predictable (committed) / Isolated (dedicated infra). Keeps meaning inline.

Kemi: UX: default the calculator to 'Estimated monthly spend (USD)' with a tiny toggle that switches to 'Per request'. Add small "assumptions" link to show tokens/request and calls/day.

Jon: Routing: when someone registers for pricing webinar, capture field `est_monthly_spend`. If est_monthly_spend >= 1500 AND company_domain not personal -> route to SDR queue; else marketing nurture. I'll own the flows.

Laura: FAQ bullets (short):
1) "How are charges calculated?" -> per 1k tokens, link to docs.
2) "Can I bring my model?" -> yes: Dedicated/Private options.
3) "Do you offer SLAs?" -> list tiers with brief SLA.
4) "Can I change plan mid-cycle?" -> prorated upgrades.
5) "Is data retained?" -> retention policy + opt-outs.
6) "Volume discounts?" -> contact sales.

Marta: Good. Also want a small benchmark snippet: show a sample assistant workload (avg 3k tokens/day) and cost per tier so people can quickly map. Ethan can you mock numbers?

Ethan: Using sample numbers: Starter $0.07/1k, Predictable $0.045/1k, Isolated $0.028/1k. Benchmark card will show monthly cost and median p95 latency.

Kemi: A/B test idea: Variant A emphasizes "Estimated monthly spend" as the main CTA metric. Variant B emphasizes "Cost per 1k tokens". Measure demo requests and signups separately.

Jon: I'll add experiment flags: pricing_calc_primary_metric and pricing_tier_labels_v3. DeployBot will expose them to QA.

InsightsBot: Experiment flags created: pricing_calc_primary_metric, pricing_tier_labels_v3.

Laura: Small copy tweak: change "Estimated monthly spend" label to "Estimated monthly spend (USD)" and the calculator footer: "This is an estimate based on your inputs."

Marta: Timeline check: copy freeze by tomorrow noon, design mock Wed AM, front-end flags Wed/Thu, QA Friday. Final webinar gating rule locked before Thursday.

Ethan: I'll post the final tier microcopy and benchmark numbers by 2pm.

Kemi: UX will deliver mock variants by end of day for design review.

Jon: Routing rules will be pushed to staging before QA window. Will share flow export here.

Marta: Perfect. If anyone has objections to the SDR threshold (1500) raise now, else we'll proceed. :sparkles:
